$comment: Merge into permissions.allow, alongside the stack-agnostic entries from
core. Everything below parses, analyses or renders — nothing installs a
module, edits a profile, or touches the running machine.
`pwsh -NoProfile` is the entry that matters. Without -NoProfile every
invocation loads the user's profile, which is both slower and the exact
hazard this overlay exists to document: a profile that prints turns any
captured invocation into mixed output. Allow the -NoProfile form and let
Deliberately absent: `Install-Module` (writes outside the repository even
with -Scope CurrentUser; tool/doctor.sh names the command and a human
mutations that need admin and cannot be undone by re-running anything),
and any write to $PROFILE. Same reasoning as core leaving out `git push`.
